situation: Opened the slice 2 and slice 3 PRs with their base set to the previous slice's harness branch (stacked PRs #49 and #50). After slice 1 was squash-merged into main (#48), the later PRs showed conflicts and could not be merged.
cause: A squash-merge puts one new commit on main, so the older branches still contain the original commits. Git sees the same lines changed in two different ways.
fix: Make a fresh branch from origin/main in a worktree, cherry-pick the slice's own commit, push, open a new PR that supersedes the old one (#51 and #52), close the old PR. Next time: every prompt branches from main, and you wait for the previous PR to merge before pasting the next prompt.
